description: This file defines the LocalDateInterval class, which manages date interval operations such as creation, containment checks, and date difference calculations within the Fineract project.

classes.name: LocalDateInterval
classes.description: Encapsulates a date interval with start and end dates, providing methods for interval operations such as containment, duration calculation, and comparison.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new LocalDateInterval with specified start and end dates.

methods.name: LocalDateInterval
methods.description: Constructor initializing the date interval with start and end dates.

methods.name: startDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the interval.

methods.name: endDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the interval.

methods.name: daysInPeriodInclusiveOfEndDate
methods.description: Calculates the number of days in the interval, inclusive of the end date.

methods.name: daysBetween
methods.description: Helper method that returns the exact difference in days between start and end dates.

methods.name: containsPortionOf
methods.description: Checks if this interval contains any portion of another interval.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if this interval fully contains another interval.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Determines if a specific date falls within the interval.

methods.name: isBetweenInclusive
methods.description: Checks if a target date is inclusively between start and end dates.

methods.name: fallsBefore
methods.description: Checks if the interval ends before a specified date.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of this interval.
